description: List every portfolio and strategy the other tools accept by id, with a one-line description, holdings, headline CAGR / max drawdown / Sharpe with the start month and the data month, and the marketheist.io page and guide URLs. Three kinds: `template` (19 buy-and-hold model portfolios such as classic-60-40, all-weather, golden-butterfly, permanent; used as `template` in analyze_portfolio, portfolio_returns, portfolio_risk, compare_portfolios, decompose_factors), `strategy` (7 rule-based canonical strategies such as dual-momentum-gem and faber-trend-timing; used as `strategy`), and `library_strategy` (19 curated single-asset backtest strategies, usable as holdings via {source:'backtest-public', strategyId} in analyze_portfolio). Call this first when you do not know an id, to avoid guessing. `query` filters by name, id or a holding ticker (e.g. 'gold', 'TLT'). Read-only and precomputed (data through the stated month); the numbers are full-window headline figures over each entry's own start, so use compare_portfolios for a like-for-like comparison.

kind.description: Which list: template (model portfolios), strategy (canonical rule-based strategies), library_strategy (curated backtest strategies) or all. Default all.

query.description: Optional filter on name, id, description or a holding ticker, e.g. 'gold', 'momentum', 'TLT'.

name: list_portfolios
